claims.statement: BulkTransferBatch status is pending → processing → completing → completed (or failed); the `completing` state is set inside a SELECT … FOR UPDATE by UpdateWithLock and triggers the book_batch_ledger task. If the process dies between lock commit and ledger write, the completing-recovery cron re-attempts booking.

The batch-level outbox (EnqueueState) is pending (batch row committed, per-row asynq tasks NOT yet enqueued — the crash window) or enqueued (all per-row tasks enqueued); ListByEnqueueState(pending, olderThan) is the outbox sweeper query.
UpdateWithLock returns (shouldBook bool, err error) rather than a sentinel error so GORM can roll back on real failures without conflating the no-booking-needed signal with a failure.
UpdateColumns writes only the targeted columns (total_fee, ledger_txn_id, status) so concurrent bumps to success_count and failed_count are not clobbered during ProcessBookBatchLedger.

DecrementTotalCount atomically subtracts n from total_count when a row fails before a wallet_payment is created (ErrDuplicatePaymentInProgress, ErrFeeResolution, pre-flight balance rejection), guarded against pushing total_count below success_count+failed_count.

The wallet payment state machine (pending → verified → authorised → completed | failed | reversed) only reaches terminal via IPN-driven transitions in production; status_inquiry_worker and disbursement_poller_worker are the safety net for missed webhooks.

The system is provider-agnostic per ADR-003: internal/infra/disbursement/onepay/ is the production adapter and internal/infra/disbursement/ninepay/ is the sandbox adapter; the registry_selector picks the active provider at runtime based on config.

Recovery sweepers verified_transfer_recovery.go and transfer_paid_amounts.go handle batches stuck in `completing` and reconcile provider-side paid totals with local wallet payments, both registered in bootstrap/routes.go.

wallet_settlement_worker reconciles advance payments against the disbursed salary: for each wallet payment it walks the employee's open advance_payment_requests, marks each as settled against the salary batch, and writes the matching ledger entries.
